description: Building the laced and cleaned books into the standing press under even pressure, with tins set into the joints, to set the form of the spine and joints permanently. Hand-printed sheets and plates are protected with tissues or tins, and the books are left under pressure overnight.
name: pressing

source_ref.label: Douglas Cockerell, Bookbinding and the Care of Books (1902), Chapter IX, p.124. Internet Archive.
